correctness.rationale: The cumulant MGF gives the exact scalar extremum. The factorial convolution produces decreasing coefficient quotients; their weighted covariance proves strict monotonicity of the stationary function for every positive real tilt. Endpoint limits give the precise threshold and unique optimizer, and analytic inversion gives both expansions. The independent standard-library checker passed 624 finite diagnostics. The proof does not infer universal claims from those tests.

value.rationale: The exact variance-matched right-tail Bernstein scale is a motivated concentration invariant, and independent Gaussian smoothing is natural. The theorem proves a complete nontrivial phase boundary between cumulant control and unique interior tilt, supplies transition curvature and a logarithmic high-noise law; none is a bare restatement of the previously available supremum representation.
